title: Repentant Living
definition: Repentant Living is the ongoing practice of turning from sin to God with humility, faith, and renewed obedience.
summary: Repentant Living is the ongoing practice of turning from sin to God with humility, faith, and renewed obedience.
christFocus: Jesus calls sinners to repentance and gives grace that not only forgives but also leads His people into new life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Repentance is not a one-time religious word that becomes irrelevant after conversion. Believers continue to turn from sin as the Holy Spirit exposes what does not honor Christ.

Repentant living includes confession, grief over sin, faith in God’s mercy, and practical turning toward obedience. It rejects both denial and despair.

Christ receives repentant sinners. His grace makes honest confession safe because forgiveness is found in Him, not in self-defense.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Shame often tells people to hide, while pride tells them to excuse sin. Repentant living offers a better way: come into the light and return to Christ.

This doctrine is vital for recovery because freedom grows through honest turning, not secret compromise.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Practice quick repentance. When the Spirit convicts you, confess honestly, receive Christ’s forgiveness, make changes where needed, and walk forward in grace.
